en: After it's added, the enablement is Pending Prerequisites and the system checks it automatically.
zh-CN: 添加后进入等前置，系统自动检查。

en: Execution status is maintained by the system from prerequisites and can't be switched on here. To stop it temporarily, use Suspend in the list. Closing removes it from the agreement and its pricing requirement; including it again returns it to Pending Prerequisites and checks it again.
zh-CN: 执行状态由系统按前置条件维护，这里不能直接开通；需要临时停用请在列表中点「暂停」。改为「关闭」后开通项退出合同、不再要求定价；重新「纳入」会回到「等前置」并重新检查。

en: Include: part of the agreement and must be priced. Close: leaves the agreement and Checkout stops offering it immediately.
zh-CN: 纳入：在合同内，定价必须覆盖；关闭：退出合同，Checkout 立即不再提供
合同不在生效期内（当前状态：{agreementStatus}）。

en: This enablement isn't within its effective period.
Not checked yet; channel identity will be included automatically once its lookup goes live.
zh-CN: 暂未接入校验，渠道身份查询上线后自动纳入

en: The qualification service couldn't be reached; the status stays unchanged. Check again later.
zh-CN: 资格服务暂时无法查询，状态保持不变，请稍后重新检查。

en: Client {clientId} isn't qualified yet. Complete the Client's due diligence first.
zh-CN: Client {clientId} 尚未取得资格，请先完成该 Client 的尽调。

en: Not applicable to this kind of enablement.

zh-CN: Operating Entity {entityNo} 尚未取得资格。

en: {currencies, select, none {The active {termType} term version doesn't price every currency and condition of this enablement.} other {The active {termType} term version has no price for {currencies} on this enablement.}}
zh-CN: {currencies, select, none {生效中的 {termType} 条款版本未覆盖本开通项的全部币种与条件。} other {生效中的 {termType} 条款版本没有本开通项 {currencies} 的价格。}}

en: There's no active {termType} term version for this agreement.
zh-CN: 该合同没有生效中的 {termType} 条款版本。

en: {code} suspended manually; resume it to continue
zh-CN: {code} 已手动暂停，需手动恢复

en: Enablements are switched on by the system once their prerequisites are met: qualification, agreement and pricing, and channel identity.
zh-CN: 开通项由系统按前置条件自动开通：资格、合同与价格、渠道身份

en: Suspended manually: the prerequisite gate won't change it. Resume it to check again.
zh-CN: 已手动暂停：前置门禁不会改变它，恢复后重新检查。

en: No prerequisite results for this enablement.
zh-CN: 该开通项没有前置检查结果。

en: The system checks qualification, agreement and pricing, and channel identity right away. If anything is missing it stays Pending Prerequisites; expand "What's Missing" on the enablement to see why.
zh-CN: 系统会立刻检查资格、合同与价格、渠道身份；有未满足的项会停在「等前置」，在开通项上展开「还差什么」可以看到原因。

en: The agreement is in effect and the active price version covers this enablement.
zh-CN: 合同生效，生效中的价格版本已覆盖本开通项

en: Client {clientId} and Operating Entity {entityNo} are qualified.
zh-CN: Client {clientId} 与经营主体 {entityNo} 资格有效
经营主体 {entityNo} 资格未通过

en: {currencies, select, none {Price doesn't cover it} other {Price doesn't cover {currencies}}}
zh-CN: {currencies, select, none {价格未覆盖} other {价格未覆盖 {currencies}}}

en: Checkout stops offering {name} to consumers; other payment methods aren't affected
zh-CN: Checkout 不再向消费者提供 {name}；其他支付方式不受影响

en: Payments, refunds and disputes already started continue as usual
zh-CN: 已经发起的支付、退款和争议照常处理

en: The system won't resume it automatically. Click Resume on this enablement; prerequisites are checked again after resuming
zh-CN: 系统不会自动恢复，需要在此开通项上点「恢复」，恢复后重新检查前置
暂停原因（写入变更历史）

en: Everything is satisfied; suspended automatically if anything lapses
zh-CN: 前置全部满足；任一项失效时系统自动暂停

en: Enabled automatically once everything is satisfied; no manual step needed
zh-CN: 全部满足后系统自动开通，无需手动操作

en: Re-enabled automatically once everything is satisfied again
zh-CN: 全部恢复满足后系统自动重新开通

en: This agreement has no enablements yet. Add them under a subscribed product; each one starts as Pending Prerequisites until qualification, the agreement and pricing are in place.
zh-CN: 该合同还没有开通项。请在已订阅的产品下添加；新开通项先处于等前置，资格、合同与价格就绪后自动开通。

zh-CN: {total} 个开通项 · {enabled} 已开通 · {pending} 等前置 · {suspended} 暂停
